demo.resultsBody: You held the five forest outposts. The full game adds 25 more across five biomes, four pilots, and an endless mode.

endlessUnlocked.title: Endless Mode Unlocked
endlessUnlocked.subtitle: Final outpost held — now survive as long as you can
endlessUnlocked.body: With the campaign's last outpost secured, the Endless protocol is live. Pick a dedicated arena and hold the line against waves that never stop and only escalate — more enemies, tougher hides, faster packs, and a matriarch every five waves. There is no win condition; the run ends when your lives run out. Your best wave per arena is saved locally.

modesUnlocked.title: Challenge Modes Unlocked
modesUnlocked.subtitle: Three stars cleared — new ways to play
modesUnlocked.body: Three-starring a level now unlocks two new modes for it. Pick them from a level's mode menu on the world map. Each mode beaten adds one bonus star to the level, up to a max of 5.
modesUnlocked.detailBreach: Tougher waves and a denied tower slot. Pick from the level's mode menu — clearing earns a bonus star.
modesUnlocked.detailContainment: One life. A locked loadout. No selling. The campaign's hardest variant — clearing earns a bonus star.

tutorial.welcomeTitle: Learn the controls on a safe field
tutorial.welcome: Move Leela, try every ability, then build and command your defense. Replay any chapter later.
tutorial.controlsFocused: HUD controls: D-pad to focus, A to use. X returns to the field.
tutorial.fieldFocused: Field cursor: stick + A. X switches to HUD controls.

hints.mouse: Click controls and amber field markers. {{robot}} selects Leela; {{abilities}} use her abilities.
hints.touch: Tap controls and amber field markers. Open Build for towers; drag then confirm, or tap to place.
hints.gamepad: X switches between HUD controls and the field. D-pad + A uses controls; stick + A picks a field position.

selectRobot.detail: Click her portrait or the marked robot. She fires automatically at nearby enemies.

moveRobot.objective: Move Leela into the amber ring.
moveRobot.detail: With Leela selected, choose the marked point on the road. Move orders need a legal road destination.

dash.objective: Aim Phase Step toward the marked target.
dash.detail: Activate the first ability, then choose the amber ring to commit the dash. Activating aim alone does not finish this lesson.

burst.objective: Hit the nearby target with Tesla Pulse.
burst.detail: Use the second ability for a short-range electric burst. The target is close enough; cooldowns let you try again.

buff.objective: Use Phase Veil while Leela attacks.
buff.detail: The third ability boosts speed, fire rate, damage and resistance. Stay near the target until a boosted shot lands.

storm.objective: Hit the target with Storm Surge.
storm.detail: Use the fourth ability. Its electric storm keeps striking enemies nearby. Every pilot has a different set of abilities.

build.objective: Place a Pulse tower beside the road.
build.detail: Choose Pulse from Build, then place it in the amber ring. Towers fire automatically; roads and blocking props reject construction.

inspectTower.detail: Select the tower to see range, damage, upgrade branches and shooting priorities.

upgrade.objective: Buy one upgrade on either branch.
upgrade.detail: Use the tower panel. Field upgrades spend mission gold and last for this mission. Each branch changes different stats.

target.objective: Change the shooting priority to Strong.
target.detail: Select Strong in the tower panel. The tower now favors enemies with the highest maximum HP in range.

vulnerable.detail: This mode favors targets vulnerable to this tower’s damage type. Re-selecting the current mode does not count as a change.

hive.objective: Place a Hive beside the two towers.
hive.detail: Hive is support: its drones boost other towers rather than shoot enemies. Place it at the amber ring.

assign.objective: Assign an idle drone to the marked Pulse.
assign.detail: In the Hive panel, choose an idle drone, then select Pulse on the field. Each base drone adds {{buff}}% fire rate; at most {{cap}} drones can support one tower.

reassign.objective: Move that drone from Pulse to Chain.
reassign.detail: Select the assigned drone in the Hive panel, then the marked Chain tower. Drones can serve any offensive tower across the map.

mortar.objective: Place a Mortar beside the road.
mortar.detail: Mortars deal explosive area damage. Place one at the amber ring to practice fixed-position fire.

spot.objective: Aim Mortar’s Spot mode at the amber ring.
spot.detail: Select Spot, then choose the marked road point inside its range. Spot fires at a fixed position rather than following an enemy.

prop.detail: Inspect the tree, then pay to remove it. Removing trees and rocks opens build space and costs mission gold.

base.detail: Inspect the marked base at the end of the road, then buy one upgrade. HQ weapons are your last line of defense.

sell.objective: Sell the marked Pulse and receive its refund.
sell.detail: Use Sell in its panel. You recover part of its cost. Some challenge modes disable selling.

enemy.detail: Read its damage multipliers: kinetic is effective; electric, flame and explosive damage are resisted. Higher multipliers mean more damage.

counter.objective: Place a kinetic Pulse and hit the Triceratops.
counter.detail: Build Pulse at the amber ring. Watch it damage the armored target. Cryo can slow enemies; damage types and resistance chips affect your choices.

wave.detail: Use Start waves. Before a real wave, check the lanes and enemy defenses, then build. Starting the first wave gives no early-call bonus.

early.objective: Call the next wave early and earn gold.
early.detail: A fresh between-wave window is ready. Use Call wave while its reward is positive. This trades preparation time for extra mission gold.

lab.objective: Open the Lab and spend one practice star.
lab.detail: Campaign results award permanent stars. Lab upgrades improve future towers. These 3 stars are practice tokens; your saved stars stay unchanged.

robotSkill.objective: Open Robots and buy a skill rank for Leela.
robotSkill.detail: Select Leela, then buy a skill rank. Kills earn permanent bolts and robot XP; XP grants skill points. This wallet and XP are practice copies.

complete.detail: You practiced movement, abilities, building and progression. Optional chapters teach every shooting priority and tower combat against enemy defenses. Open Chapters or exit to your unchanged save.

defend.objective: Let your defense defeat a wave enemy.
defend.detail: Watch the wave you started. Your Pulse fires when enemies enter range. This lesson waits for a real kill.

aimNear.objective: Choose Near and hit the closest target.
aimNear.detail: The center target is closest to Pulse. Select Near; wait for its shot to land. The amber ring marks the expected target.

aimFirst.objective: Choose End and hit the lead target.
aimFirst.detail: End favors the enemy farthest along its path toward HQ. Choose End and watch the rightmost target take damage.

aimLast.objective: Choose Start and hit the rear target.
aimLast.detail: Start favors the enemy nearest the start of its path. Choose Start and watch Pulse hit the leftmost target.

aimStrong.objective: Choose Strong and hit the largest HP pool.
aimStrong.detail: The left target has the highest maximum HP. Strong uses maximum HP, even when another target has less health remaining.

aimWeak.objective: Choose Weak and hit the wounded target.
aimWeak.detail: The right target has the least current HP. Weak favors low current HP; shielded enemies use maximum HP while their shield remains.

aimVulnerable.objective: Choose Vuln and hit the Triceratops.
aimVulnerable.detail: Pulse deals kinetic damage. This target takes more kinetic damage than the nearby raptors. Inspect its multipliers, then choose Vuln.

aimSpot.objective: Use Spot to hit both clustered targets.
aimSpot.detail: Select Spot, then aim at the amber ring. Wait for Mortar’s shell to explode and damage both nearby targets.

targetingComplete.detail: You used every shooting priority and observed its result. Open Chapters for optional combat drills, replay a chapter, or exit to your save.

chainHits.objective: Build Chain and hit three enemies at once.
chainHits.detail: Place Chain in the amber ring. Its electric attack jumps between nearby targets. Wait for one volley to damage all three.

burnRegen.detail: This practice Pyre has Lab Ignite. Buy its final Combustion upgrade. Direct fire then pauses so you can see its {{burnDps}} DPS burn continue and prevent regeneration.

cryoFreeze.objective: Buy {{cryoUpgrade}} and freeze a moving target.
cryoFreeze.detail: This Cryo has Lab Flash Freeze: {{freezeChance}}% chance per hit. Buy its final Subzero upgrade. Watch moving targets slow, stop healing, and eventually freeze.

shieldBreak.detail: Upgrade Mortar’s Breach branch, then watch its shell break the blue shield. Shields can start regenerating {{shieldDelay}} seconds after a break.

healerPriority.objective: Use Weak to defeat the healer.
healerPriority.detail: The marked healer restores {{healRate}} HP per second to nearby allies. Its own HP is lowest. Choose Weak to remove it and stop the healing.

resistStrip.detail: This raptor carries an electric resistance chip. Buy Chain’s final Voltage upgrade. Inspect the target as real hits weaken that chip.

armorPierce.objective: Buy {{pierceUpgrade}} and bypass the resistance chip.
armorPierce.detail: This raptor resists kinetic hits through an extra chip. Buy Pulse’s final Ballistics upgrade and watch a full-strength shot land. Native species resistance still applies.

adaptMix.detail: This practice herd adapted after a kinetic-heavy wave. Inspect its extra resistance, then build Chain in the amber ring. Finish by dealing both kinetic and electric damage.

combatComplete.detail: You used chain attacks, burn, slow, freeze, shield breaking, healer priority and resistance counters. Reset or replay any chapter from Chapters. Exit restores your original session.

epilogue.title: The last directive
epilogue.subtitle: Outpost 30 · Final field report
epilogue.body1: The apex specimen is down. The revival site is quiet. Beyond the perimeter, the biocrust still spreads.
epilogue.body2: Vance’s recording remains in the station archive. We add the engagement log beneath it. No new order arrives.
epilogue.signoff: The operator closes the channel. The outpost holds.
epilogue.starGoal: {{count}} normal stars remain. Finish each outpost with all 20 lives for three stars.
epilogue.starsComplete: Every outpost has three normal stars. Try another robot or a higher difficulty.
epilogue.challengeGoal: {{count}} challenge stars remain. Three normal stars at an outpost open its Breach and Containment modes.
epilogue.challengesComplete: Every Breach and Containment challenge is complete. Try a different robot for your next defense.
epilogue.revisit: Replay this ending from the world-map menu.
